references.text: Here it is told how Isaac was born as the son of Sarah and Abraham, which points forward to Jesus' birth as a fulfillment of God's promises.
The prophecy about a virgin who will give birth to a son, and they shall call him Immanuel, which points directly to Jesus' birth.
Describes Jesus' birth from Joseph and Mary's perspective, complementing the account in Luke.
Refers to Jesus as the firstborn among many brothers, connecting to his status as Mary's firstborn.
